# agents.UpdateAgentSettingsInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Changes enabled agents, web opt-ins, the PII mode or the organization's own lower budget cap.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.UpdateAgentSettingsInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.agent-settings.update` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `budget` | no | `none` | The organization's own lower monthly cap; null removes it. |  |
| `enabledAgents` | no | `none` | Subagents the supervisor may delegate to. |  |
| `guardrails` | no | `none` | PII detector mode for user input. |  |
| `webTools` | no | `none` | Web tool opt-ins (the platform flag ai.web-tools must also be on). |  |

_None._
